prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL square 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR separate large-looking inflatable soft sculptures isolated on TRUE transparent background. Fixed order top-left shopping tote bag silhouette with closed inflated body and chunky loop handles; top-right two overlapping blank inflated coin-disc cushions; bottom-left shield silhouette with one clear thick checkmark; bottom-right compact weight silhouette with a round lifting-hole loop. Every shape is made from pressurized flexible welded coated fabric/PVC: bulging broad lobes, visibly pinched welded perimeter seams, a few gentle tension wrinkles near handles/corners, a small unobtrusive air valve on each sculpture. Rounded air pressure surfaces with wide soft highlights and slight fabric grain, restrained coral-orange, cream, muted blue and pale yellow palette. Forms feel hollow and full of air, not solid clay, ceramic, polished metal, gelatin or ordinary flat icons. No claim the weight has real mass; all are playful original symbolic soft sculptures. Front three-quarter studio camera and consistent upper-left diffuse light, no extreme fisheye, no floating unrelated balloon strings. Four complete independent sculptures, wide empty transparent central cross at least 12 percent of canvas width, generous transparent outer margin, no clipped valves or handles, no objects touching across quadrants. No text, numerals, currency marks, brand logos, signatures, people, hands, equipment, scenery or watermarks.
scope: Original illustrative concepts, not real products, artifacts, manufacturing footage or physically validated builds
